question.en: Discuss the significance of the Rainbow Revolution in achieving nutritional security in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Rainbow Revolution in achieving nutritional security in India.

modelAnswer.en: The Rainbow Revolution shifts focus from mere food grain self-sufficiency to nutritional security by promoting diverse food groups like fruits, vegetables, milk, and fish, thereby addressing hidden hunger and improving rural livelihoods.
